feature_hypothesis.causal_source: Official ThetaData SPX/VIX 1m history rebuilt under v3.2 BAR_OPEN_TIMESTAMP +60-second availability; both current source clocks must be <= decision_time

formulas.spx_realized_vol: 5m/15m annualized RMS log-return volatility using completed minutes
formulas.time: New_York minutes since 09:30 and minutes remaining to 15:55

feature_hypothesis.live_twin: v4.live.protocol101_live_entry LiveIndexState.market_window supplies the same completed-minute SPX/VIX values and derives cumulative session_range with a completed-minute cutoff; exact historical selection is event_time+60<=decision

guards.G1_controls_and_feature_attribution: candidate mean OOF rho > shuffled +0.01; candidate mean econ > shuffled and sign-reversed; candidate mean rho > paired old-family baseline +0.01; candidate mean econ > paired baseline; incremental rho/econ nonnegative in fold5; and incremental econ >0 in >=4/5 folds
guards.G2_forward_stability: fold5 candidate rho>=0 and econ>=0; candidate rho>0 in >=4/5 and econ>0 in >=4/5
guards.G3_minimum_power: min over folds n_enter>=40 and n_sessions>=20
guards.G4_economic_bar: mean candidate econ>0 and candidate econ>0 in >=4/5 folds

hard_rule: No entry-model artifact unless one candidate passes all development guards, is selected before holdout access, and passes the one-shot holdout bar

holdout_protocol.model_artifact_rule: write only after pass; otherwise no model artifact
holdout_protocol.pass_bar: OOF-style holdout rho>0, session-clustered econ>0, n_enter>=40, n_sessions>=20, and conservative one-sided bootstrap LCB at alpha=0.05/144>0

purpose: Fresh causal volatility/regime/time entry hypothesis; NULL is first-class; research-only and not promotable

selection.ordering: descending worst-fold econ, descending mean paired incremental econ, descending mean OOF rho, then ascending canonical config SHA-256
